note: The five shared HOME scenes (D-163): the one rule for every game's background in the website's HOME and in the console and computer HOME packages. A game's scene follows its genre; a game without a listed genre (no genre, imported, personal) gets the fallback. No title is assigned by hand, and nothing a collection stores chooses a scene. Each scene is static human-made pixel art by Luis Zuno (Ansimuz), composed by tools/publish/make_scenes.py from the artist's own published layer files (their checksums, the license and the changes are recorded with each scene).

credit.title: Magic Cliffs Environment
credit.changes: Composed from the artist's background layers at their native pixel size, cropped to 16:9 and enlarged by a whole number with nearest-neighbor sampling (each original pixel kept as a sharp square). Nothing drawn, generated or retouched.
credit.note: Used under the CC BY 3.0 license included with the artist's files.
